title: Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse - Bloodstained Rush 🩸 ~ Beginning (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝔄𝔣𝔱𝔢𝔯 𝔱𝔥𝔦𝔰 𝔣𝔦𝔤𝔥𝔱
𝔱𝔥𝔢 𝔅𝔢𝔩𝔪𝔬𝔫𝔱 𝔫𝔞𝔪𝔢
𝔰𝔥𝔞𝔩𝔩 𝔟𝔢 𝔥𝔬𝔫𝔬𝔯𝔢𝔡
𝔟𝔶 𝔞𝔩𝔩 𝔭𝔢𝔬𝔭𝔩𝔢. ❞
ㅤ- Ending, Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse (1989)



Did an arrangement of Beginning from Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse Akumajou Densetsu in celebration of Castlevania: Belmont's Curse being announced. Really wanted to make something unique out of this song given it's the third major Castlevania theme (and I already did the other two major tracks, Vampire Killer & Bloody Tears in the past).

Important:
ㅤ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7) ← (I did put the ActRaiser Organ in that spot if you just so happen to need it)
ㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. D Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. D# Minor (Super Pitch)
ㅤ3. C Minor (Dracula X Pitch)
ㅤ4. E Minor (Perfect Selection Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the voice clip, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (Voice Enabled)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Disables the voice clip & Decreases the Echo (Voice Disabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
